title: Technocraft Ventures IPO Details
intro:
Technocraft Ventures IPO is a book build issue of ₹251.88 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 0.95 crore shares aggregating to ₹201.51 crores and offer for sale of 0.24 crore shares aggregating to ₹50.37 crores.

Technocraft Ventures IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 7, 2026 and will close on Aug 11, 2026. The allotment for the Technocraft Ventures IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 12, 2026. Technocraft Ventures IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 14, 2026.

Technocraft Ventures IPO is set issue price band at ₹200 to ₹212 per share. The lot size for an application is 70 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,840 (70 shares) (based on upper price).

Khambatta Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Technocraft Ventures IPO RHP for detailed Information.

The company works across multiple infrastructure sectors, delivering projects mainly for state governments and government agencies in northern India, including Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, and the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

Water & Wastewater Infrastructure – Designing and building water supply schemes, sewerage networks, sewage and wastewater treatment plants, transmission mains, and reservoirs, as well as providing long-term operation and maintenance services.
Roads & Highways – Executing road and national highway projects.
Urban Infrastructure – Sector-level planning and residential building projects.
Power Distribution – Implementing electrification schemes, constructing substations, and installing transmission lines.
Trenchless & Micro-Tunnelling Works – Laying pipelines in crowded areas with minimal disruption to the surface.
The company has executed projects under schemes including AMRUT, JNNURM, UIDSST, Namami Gange, JJM, and PMGSY.
The company has experience implementing ADB-funded infrastructure projects with rigorous technical and environmental standards.

Incorporated in October 1998, Technocraft Ventures Ltd., is a public infrastructure development company that undertakes turnkey Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) projects. The company works across multiple infrastructure sectors, delivering projects mainly for state governments and government agencies in northern India, including Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, and the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

Its services cover a wide range of areas:

Water & Wastewater Infrastructure – Designing and building water supply schemes, sewerage networks, sewage and wastewater treatment plants, transmission mains, and reservoirs, as well as providing long-term operation and maintenance services.

Roads & Highways – Executing road and national highway projects.

Urban Infrastructure – Sector-level planning and residential building projects.

Power Distribution – Implementing electrification schemes, constructing substations, and installing transmission lines.

Trenchless & Micro-Tunnelling Works – Laying pipelines in crowded areas with minimal disruption to the surface.

The company has executed projects under schemes including AMRUT, JNNURM, UIDSST, Namami Gange, JJM, and PMGSY.

The company has experience implementing ADB-funded infrastructure projects with rigorous technical and environmental standards.

As of May 31, 2026, Technocraft Ventures employed 170 full-time staff, including 78 engineers, across functions such as engineering, procurement, finance, safety, business development, and administration.

The company's strengths include its broad EPC capabilities and proven record of executing high-value projects.

Technocraft Ventures Ltd.'s revenue increased by 23% and profit after tax (PAT) rose by 54% between the financial year ending with March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025.

faqs.question: How to apply in Technocraft Ventures IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Technocraft Ventures IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Technocraft Ventures IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Technocraft Ventures IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Technocraft Ventures IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: Technocraft Ventures IPO lot size is 70 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,840 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Technocraft Ventures IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Technocraft Ventures IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Technocraft Ventures IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Technocraft Ventures IPO will be done on Wednesday, August 12, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Aug 13, 2026 . Check the Technocraft Ventures IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Technocraft Ventures IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Technocraft Ventures IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Aug 14, 2026 .
